description: This file contains unit tests for the ModifyFeaturesResponse class in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically testing JSON serialization/deserialization, immutability, and equality semantics related to modification of feature responses within the 'things' commands module.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesResponseTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ModifyFeaturesResponse class, including JSON serialization, immutability, and equality checks.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the ModifyFeaturesResponse class and related features are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals() and hashCode() methods for ModifyFeaturesResponse using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson() method produces the expected JSON output for created and modified responses.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that ModifyFeaturesResponse can be correctly instantiated from valid JSON input.
